answers.question: When the loop drops the player back on the title card after the Grocery Store, what should they feel, in one line?
answers.answer: Trapped: there was never a way out

answers.question: What word do you use for it?
What should this teardown help you decide next?
answers.answer: whether to grow it and make merge it with the intern in some fashion

answers.question: Each loading screen is the clip and nothing else: no overlay, no LOG, no sound toggle, exactly 5.0 seconds. What is a loading screen to you?
SKIP is offered during every loading clip and every walk, so no room is a dead end. Do you want people to use it?
Phone or desktop first: which one do you play it on yourself?
The three mini games (Lights Out, Fill the Frames, Shopping List) are bonuses: the exit is open from the start. Should any of them ever gate the exit?
Only three of the seven rooms have a mini game. What about the other four (hallway, both teal rooms, trampoline park)?
Which room is the best to walk, and which feels unfinished?
The captions and logs follow one first-person voice going deeper: "They said to wait in the dining room", "I have to keep moving". Who is the narrator to you?
The four phases run Departure from Reality → Holding Cells → System Breakdown → Empty Expanse. Is a room missing?
Do the clock stamps (14:32 → 27:81 → SysTime: 88:88 → ERR_CLOCK_NOT_FOUND → DISTANCE: NaN → PING_DETECTED_0x8F) carry the story, or are they texture?
The room videos came first, and the 3D rooms were built afterwards to match them, beat for beat. Which is the real room to you?
How were the room videos, loading clips and section tracks made?
Each room's track plays on under the walk, and the walk adds small synthesized sounds (hum, buzz, drip, groan, chime). What should a room sound like when nothing is happening?
What is the slowest phone it must run on?
The walk test (Playwright, headless Chromium, desktop and --mobile) runs only by hand: the repo has no CI. Should it run on every push?
The loading clips and room videos differ only by case (a.MP4 / A.mp4), which collides on macOS and Windows checkouts. Rename them, or keep the pairs?
